summary: The packet documents ongoing BLA review and acute and maintenance GEMINI studies, but provides no interpretable efficacy results or safety findings to support a directional clinical assessment.
pivotalQuestion: What efficacy and safety results support the application when acute and maintenance periods are separated by population and comparator?

factors.rationale: GEMINI includes acute controlled efficacy and longer-term maintenance follow-up, but the supplied summaries provide no efficacy outcomes. Different periods and populations cannot establish a single two-year placebo-controlled effect.
No safety results are supplied; study titles referencing safety do not establish tolerability or characterize adverse events.
The packet provides no product-linked manufacturing, facility inspection, or CMC findings.
Vanda reported BLA acceptance and reaffirmed ongoing FDA review in August 2026, with a December 12, 2026 target. These are process milestones, not evidence of approval.
